conflict_triage.note: Claim A describes operational conditions for reconnection (devices must be within 30 ft and powered on), while Claim B reports published Bluetooth range specifications (~30 ft or up to 33 ft) from product documentation, reflecting different contexts: usage behavior vs. technical specification.

Claim A states a 15-minute charge provides up to 3 hours of playback, while Claim B's detailed test notes the same 15-minute charge yields only up to 2.5 hours under identical settings, creating a direct numerical contradiction.

The two claims directly contradict on the duration of the solid blue light during connection: Claim A states 10 seconds, while Claim B states 5 seconds, with no contextual indication that these refer to different events or revisions.
